name: Kuniko Limited
summary: Kuniko Limited, an Australian-based company established in 2017, explores and develops mineral properties in Scandinavia, targeting metals for electromobility such as copper, nickel and cobalt. Its portfolio includes the Ertelien Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, the Ringerike Battery Metals Project, the Skuterud cobalt project, copper prospects including Vågå, and lithium projects such as Frase and Nemaska South.
